promisingCities.title: Promising Saudi Cities
promisingCities.subtitle: Where is the new real estate investment compass pointing?
promisingCities.intro: Amid the major transformations Saudi Arabia is undergoing to achieve the goals of Vision 2030, the real estate sector stands out as one of the most important economic drivers. At Takamol Advanced, this report highlights the leading emerging destinations shaping the next wave of investment.

sections.heading: Riyadh: The Economic Center of Gravity
sections.body: The capital, Riyadh, continues to lead as the largest hub for mega projects and the regional headquarters of global companies. This momentum is generating unprecedented demand for office and commercial space, as well as high-quality residential solutions.

sections.heading: Jeddah and Dammam: Balanced Expansion
sections.body: Jeddah maintains its position as a main gateway for tourism and trade on the Red Sea, while Dammam strengthens its industrial and logistics role, creating promising investment opportunities in logistics real estate and smart warehouses.

sections.heading: Emerging Cities and Mega Projects
sections.body: Beyond the traditional centers, giga-projects such as NEOM and the Red Sea are creating entirely new destinations with unprecedented real estate requirements built on sustainability and smart-city technologies, a golden opportunity for forward-looking investors.

promisingCities.note: * This content was prepared by the strategic studies team at Takamol Advanced. We are committed to providing the most accurate data and the best solutions to empower your real estate investments.

realEstateIndex.title: Takamol Real Estate Index
realEstateIndex.subtitle: Saudi market trends for Q3 2025
realEstateIndex.intro: The Takamol Real Estate Index provides a precise analytical reading of real estate market performance in Saudi Arabia, based on the latest data and on actual supply and demand across key sectors.

sections.heading: Sustained Growth in the Commercial Sector
sections.body: Q3 data showed positive stability in occupancy rates for Grade A offices and commercial complexes, driven by new international companies entering the local market to meet regional headquarters requirements.

sections.heading: Shifts in the Residential Sector
sections.body: The index notes a shift in residential demand toward compact units and gated communities that offer a higher quality of life and integrated amenities, in line with the Quality of Life programs under Vision 2030.

sections.heading: Next Quarter Outlook
sections.body: Based on current market data, Takamol Advanced expects foreign direct investment to keep flowing into the real estate sector, with a particular focus on hospitality and mixed-use development projects.

realEstateIndex.note: * All data and analyses in this index are the intellectual property of Takamol Advanced. We provide numbers-driven consulting to support your investment decisions.

megaProjects.metaTitle: Impact of Mega Projects on the Real Estate Market
megaProjects.metaDescription: A comprehensive study by Takamol Advanced on how mega projects (NEOM, Red Sea, Diriyah) affect the dynamics of the surrounding real estate market.
megaProjects.metaKeywords: mega projects, NEOM, Red Sea, Diriyah, Qiddiya, real estate investment, Takamol Advanced, real estate study
megaProjects.title: Impact of Mega Projects
megaProjects.subtitle: On the dynamics of the surrounding real estate market (NEOM, Red Sea, Diriyah...)
megaProjects.intro: The giga-projects launched by the Saudi government are the cornerstone of the Kingdom's economic transformation. In this study, Takamol Advanced reviews their direct and indirect effects on the wider real estate landscape.

sections.heading: Creating New Real Estate Markets
sections.body: Projects such as NEOM and the Red Sea Project don't just develop land; they create complete local markets and economies. This stimulates real estate development in surrounding areas and rapidly raises the value of neighboring land.

sections.heading: The Domino Effect on Infrastructure
sections.body: The scale of these projects calls for massive logistics networks and infrastructure. This development lifts the valuation of industrial property, warehouses, and the logistics zones that serve these destinations.

sections.heading: Raising Quality and Sustainability Standards
sections.body: The strict commitment to sustainability and environmental standards in projects such as Diriyah and Qiddiya sets a new benchmark for private-sector developers. Green technologies and sustainability certifications (such as LEED) have become a core requirement rather than a luxury.

megaProjects.note: * A study prepared by the consultants of Takamol Advanced. We support your investment vision with a deep understanding of how major national projects affect your real estate portfolio.

proptech.title: The PropTech Revolution in Saudi Arabia
proptech.subtitle: How did technology change the face of the real estate sector?
proptech.intro: The Kingdom's real estate sector is going through an unprecedented digital revolution led by PropTech. Takamol Advanced believes that investing in technology is the strongest guarantee for the sustainability and growth of modern real estate portfolios.

sections.heading: Automating Property and Facility Management
sections.body: Cloud platforms and the Internet of Things (IoT) have turned traditional buildings into smart buildings capable of self-diagnosis and lower energy consumption, noticeably reducing operating costs and improving facility management.

sections.heading: Big Data Analytics
sections.body: Big data and AI have given investors unprecedented accuracy in forecasting price swings, identifying the best times to buy or sell, and measuring risk precisely instead of relying on intuition.

sections.heading: Digitizing Finance and Investment (FinTech & PropTech)
sections.body: Through real estate crowdfunding platforms and digital investment funds, access to real estate opportunities has become more flexible, broadening the investor base and noticeably boosting market liquidity.

proptech.note: * Takamol Advanced provides leading consulting on integrating PropTech solutions into real estate development projects. We build smart real estate environments that support your decisions.

Invest.title: Real Invest Engine
Invest.tagline: From a plot of land to a complete feasibility study
Invest.intro: Real Invest is the studies engine inside the Real Forsa platform. It turns any plot of land into a complete feasibility study in clear steps: analysing the plot, reading market indicators, testing the best use, assessing strengths and risks, and then producing a detailed final report you can share with partners and financiers.
steps: Choose the plot on the map
Analyse the plot's dimensions and data
Test the best use for the land
Receive the study and final report

stages.title: The land
stages.desc: Identifying the plot and understanding its location, dimensions and regulatory setting.

stages.title: Development
stages.desc: Testing use scenarios and estimating the costs and returns of each.

stages.title: The project
stages.desc: A final study that supports the development, investment or financing decision.

land.heading: Choosing the Land and Analysing the Plot
land.desc: Start from the map: pick the plot and the engine gathers its data automatically, from dimensions and area to terrain and regulations, building the foundation the whole study rests on.

items.title: Plot data
items.desc: Dimensions, area, shape, frontages and terrain.

items.title: Location & surroundings
items.desc: Streets, services and neighbouring projects, and their effect on value.

items.title: Regulations
items.desc: Permitted uses, building ratios and heights.

land.resultTitle: A sound foundation for a sound study
land.resultText: Every study starts with a precise understanding of the land itself, before any number.

market.heading: Market Indicators and Best Use
market.desc: The engine reads current prices and supply-and-demand indicators in the area, then tests the investment indicators of several scenarios to determine the best possible use of the land, with numbers rather than guesswork.

items.title: Current prices
items.desc: Actual sale and rental prices in the area and around it.

items.title: Supply & demand
items.desc: Current and expected supply against demand for each use.

items.title: Use scenarios
items.desc: Residential, commercial, mixed: alternatives tested side by side.

items.title: Investment indicators
items.desc: Return, payback period and net value for each scenario.

market.resultText: Don't guess what to build; test the alternatives with numbers and choose the highest return.

risk.heading: Assessing Strengths and Risks
risk.desc: Before the decision, the engine reviews the project's strengths and points of caution: funding, costs, timing and competition, with an estimate of each factor's effect on the final result.

items.title: Strengths
items.desc: What distinguishes the location and the project and raises its chances of success.

items.title: Potential risks
items.desc: Costs, timing, competition and regulation, with an estimate of each one's impact.

items.title: Sensitivity analysis
items.desc: How the result changes if the price, cost or duration changes.

risk.resultTitle: A decision that knows its limits
risk.resultText: You enter the project knowing what might change and how to handle it.

study.desc: The end result is a comprehensive feasibility study: an executive summary, the financial feasibility, the best use, the risk analysis and subdivision data where relevant, in a detailed report ready to share with partners and financiers.
